description: LLM Critic rubric for Azure Front Door (CDN/WAF) operations

checks: Front Door profile provisioningState is Succeeded or Failed
endpoints and routes correctly map to origin groups and origins
WAF policy association matches the expected Front Door endpoint
caching rules and compression settings match the requested configuration
Delete Front Door profile/endpoint operations include pre-confirmation show command
WAF policy deletion warns about unprotected endpoints
No credential or sensitive data in stdout/stderr
Purge cache operations specify the correct endpoint paths
Re-running the same command produces consistent output
Origin group updates merge rather than replace existing origin configurations
Route creation checks for path pattern conflicts with existing routes
Purge cache operations on already-purged paths return success
Command, exit_code, stdout, and stderr are all captured
Timestamp and iteration count are recorded
Front Door endpoint hostnames and routing rules are documented
WAF policy mode (Detection/Prevention) and custom rules are logged
All commands include --output json flag
Resource group is specified with --resource-group
Front Door profile name follows Azure naming conventions
SKU tier (Standard/Premium) is specified for profile creation
